name: pi-btw
notes: Forked from the pi-btw upstream. The transcript-builder contract lives in openspec (spec transcript-builder-api).

knownDebt.reason: Fork npm publication must identify xzzpig/pi-extensions as repository.url for OIDC provenance; upstream identity remains in this subtree record and package homepage. This minimal metadata divergence remains while publishing the fork.

Upstream package-lock.json is deleted on every sync (it resurrects on each pull) and is never consumed by this pnpm monorepo; delete it again with git rm packages/pi-btw/package-lock.json after each subtree pull.

Five pi-lens require-safety-comment-for-as-unknown-as findings are unchanged upstream casts that also predate the v0.8.0 sync. Keep upstream bytes rather than add fork-only suppressions; revisit if upstream removes or documents the casts.

reapplyOnSync: Keep package.json repository.url at git+https://github.com/xzzpig/pi-extensions.git for fork OIDC publishing; retain upstream source identity in subtree metadata.

重新应用 extensions/btw.ts 的 pi-components 迁移、共享实时事件摄入和 outcome 传递，保留 [BTW SESSION BOUNDARY] 标记：applyTranscriptEvent 委派给 btw-transcript-ingestion，transcript state 使用 btw-transcript-display resolver，overlay 通过 BtwTranscriptDisplay 渲染。工具显示适配器取得子会话 getToolDefinition(name) 的 childDefinition，并将同一对象作为公开 extensionRunner.resolveToolRenderers(name, () => childDefinition) 的基线；合法 next() 包装必须能访问子会话自己的定义。子会话自定义 renderer 逐字段优先于同名 tool-display provider，普通内置定义没有 renderer 时仍由 provider 补样式。

re-apply the fork-only overlay interaction seam: BtwOverlayComponent implements Component rather than Container, handleMouse maps overlay-local coordinates through btw-overlay-interaction into TranscriptPresenter rows, and the local thinking toggle uses the resolved PI_BTW_THINKING_KEYS shortcut (default Ctrl+T) advertised in the footer

re-apply the thread-owned transcript display and revision-cache seam: BtwTranscriptDisplay keeps the presenter/theme proxy across overlay close/reopen, BtwToolComponents rebuilds supported built-in tool components when the display-provider identity or presentationRevision changes, and the overlay caches lines by transcript version, width, and display revision
adapt upstream tests asserting the upstream renderer's 'You  <text>' user-row badge format to plain-text assertions (the fork renderer has no You label)

adapt the upstream transcript-entry tests to the shared segmenting ingestion: a tool call ends the assistant segment, so a post-tool message_end is a separate thinking/assistant-text entry and pre-tool thinking is no longer streaming
bump upstream tests asserting SessionManager.appendMessage call counts by +1 because the fork's boundary message is also seeded
delete package-lock.json again if a future subtree pull resurrects it
keep the Pi 1.x peer ranges and workspace catalog devDependencies instead of upstream SDK pins
the upstream completion test fixture supplies the fork overlay's transcript-version and tool-component lookup callbacks before the status callback

'applies distinct theme treatment' must keep its user-row assertion color-mode agnostic (\\x1b[48;2; truecolor or \\x1b[49m default background): pi 1.1 themes leave headless runs on the default background, so a truecolor-only assertion fails without proving anything about the renderer

re-apply the BTW display workspace seam: isLocalWorkspace reads a retained thread workspace mode that is set false when a remote child session is created (and never upgraded by a later local child while remote tool slots remain), reset to local only on thread reset/restore, not derived from live activeBtwSession presence
re-apply the README transcript-display compatibility section/link that points at docs/transcript-display.md so the fork-only matrix remains discoverable
保留 fork 独立发布版本、CHANGELOG 发布条目与仓库 versions.json 的一致性；不要用 upstream 版本替换 fork 版本。
doNotReintroduce: Do not restore upstream repository.url as the fork publishing source; npm provenance must identify the actual build repository.
do not adopt upstream's overlay renderer (buildOverlayTranscript plus its per-entry helpers): rendering stays on the pi-components TranscriptPresenter through BtwTranscriptDisplay
do not adopt upstream's markdownTheme/managesMouseReporting/rebuildTranscriptLines additions; SGR mouse-reporting and ownsMouseReporting stay fork-only

do not restore the per-turn upsert-based assistant ingestion (applyAssistantMessageToTranscript): live events stay on the shared applyAgentSessionEvent path so a second assistant message after a tool call appends instead of overwriting the first

do not add @xzzpig/pi-tool-display as a runtime dependency or import it from BTW; probe the global pi-tool-display.api.v1 key and fall back to native rendering when it is missing, legacy, or unsupported

do not route raw terminal mouse coordinates to transcript components or restore an input-only overlay; keep the normalized overlay-local handleMouse mapping, the local thinking toggle, and the footer key hint
do not recreate the transcript display per overlay or cache lines by transcript version/width alone; keep the thread-owned display, provider-revision tool rebuild, and detach/attach lifecycle
keep the dead removeTranscriptTurn import removed, and keep 'skills' dropped from package.json files (the directory stays to avoid subtree delete conflicts)
do not derive display localWorkspace from activeBtwSession presence or upgrade it on a local child while remote tool slots remain; keep remote permission conservative until reset/restore
不要把子会话公开 renderer 解析链的基线改为空值、父 provider 或父工具定义；保留 () => childDefinition，使 next() 取得同一子会话注册定义，避免重新引入同名 renderer 被覆盖或包装失效。
